metadata.title: Branka | Graphic Design & Digital Marketing
metadata.description: Branka is an integrated creative studio specializing in brand identity, content design, paid media and digital commerce experiences.
metadata.keywords: graphic design company, digital marketing company, creative studio, brand identity, social media design, paid media management, e-commerce design, Branka

hero.title: Design that earns attention.
hero.description: We help brands build a clear, persuasive presence—from identity and design to content and digital campaigns—with considered thinking and polished execution.
hero.founderRole: Graphic Designer • Digital Marketer • Media Buyer

about.title: Turning ideas into a presence that is hard to ignore
about.descriptionPrimary: Branka is a creative studio that connects visual thinking with marketing understanding, with our specialized team creating work that looks strong and serves a clear purpose.
about.descriptionSecondary: We approach each project as one connected system: understand the audience, sharpen the message, then build a visual direction that helps the brand show up with confidence and communicate effectively.

services.title: From idea to presence
services.description: Connected services that help your business look professional and reach its audience with a clearer message.

identity.title: Brand Identity
identity.description: A coherent visual direction across logo, color, typography and essential applications, built to make your brand recognizable.

content.title: Content Design
content.description: Social media and advertising visuals that protect brand consistency, communicate quickly and capture attention.

performance.title: Paid Media
performance.description: Meta and TikTok campaign planning and management shaped by the objective and audience, with ongoing performance improvement.

commerce.title: Web & Store Design
